claims.text: In Italy the few who believed in the power of the caul prized knowledge of its use so highly that the Padroni came to demand near-slave apprenticeships and total loyalty from anyone who wished to learn.

The Maldonati family grew as rich as the feudal lords whose lands its wagons crossed; since nobles left Gypsy affairs alone, the abuse of apprentices went unchecked until a revolt in the thirteenth century.

title: The Paranormal Research Wing
summary: Scientists who would turn ghosts into fuel.

claims.text: The Alternate Energy Group meets in Geneva each autumn to study new energy sources; its Paranormal Research Wing, radical scientists mostly from Berkeley, Edinburgh and Duke, studies industrial uses of psychic and ectoplasmic energy.
Funded by large conglomerates and obscure societies rather than governments, it seeks to turn ectoplasm into power for industry, destroying wraiths in the process.
The Orphic Circle knows more about the Underworld than any other group that hunts ghosts, but it can still be fooled, and Hierarchy leaders have begun feeding it falsehoods.
The Ebon Bench lets Puppeteers join its revels only after an oath to submit to experiments later; some say the revels are part of a great rite meant to tear the Shroud away.

title: The Bloo Moons
summary: A gang that baits Spectres with wraiths.

claims.text: The Bloo Moons lure wraiths into Tempest traps by tricking Enfants or spreading rumors, and have learned to make the spectral scream that draws Spectres and sometimes Malfeans to the bait.
A few members doubt the cruelty but go along under peer pressure; recruits must be streetwise, tough and Unhooded, and prove themselves.
